parameters.content:
## Fill ANY PDF — reviewed AI vision

This variant handles forms you have **not** templated. It renders every detected page and uses two separate vision passes:

1. map the supplied data to labelled fields;
2. render those exact values and independently review the filled pages.

The workflow calls `fill_pdf` only when the second pass returns an explicit approval with no issues. A rejected or malformed review stops the run.

**Guide and safety notes:**
https://justfill.app/integrations/n8n-fill-pdf-forms?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=b2b_pdf_automation_2026q3&utm_content=vision_template

**Setup:**
1. JustFill API key → https://justfill.app/account → API keys
2. Gemini API key → https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys
3. Paste both into the **Config** node.

Default model: `gemini-3.5-flash`. Expect two direct Gemini calls per run.

**Trade-off:** automated visual review reduces silent mistakes but is still probabilistic. Use `fill-pdf-workflow.json` (saved template, deterministic field mapping) for recurring or high-stakes documents.

parameters.formDescription: Upload a PDF (no template needed) and describe the data to put in it.

parameters.content:
### 1. Collect the PDF and the data

The form takes any PDF plus the values you want written into it. **Config** holds your JustFill API key and the vision model settings, so edit that node before the first run.

### 2. Upload the PDF safely

JustFill mints a one-time upload slot and n8n sends the file as binary multipart data. The PDF is never embedded as base64 inside a JSON request.

### 3. Detect fields and render the pages

**Open PDF** detects the fields on every page. The workflow then renders a preview image of each page, so the vision model can see the labels next to each field.

### 4. Map your data to the fields

The first vision pass matches your values to the labelled fields. **Validate mapping** rejects anything that points at a field that doesn't exist on the page.

### 5. Review the filled pages independently

JustFill renders the pages with the proposed values filled in. A second, separate vision pass checks those images, and **Require approval** stops the run if the review does not approve every page.

### 6. Fill and return the PDF

Only after approval, JustFill writes the values into the original PDF and returns a temporary download link. The final form step redirects the user to the filled file.
